content: Please consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information regarding this product and your specific health requirements. Missed Dose Instructions: If you forget to take a dose, administer it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to compensate for the missed one. Storage Guidelines: Store tablets at room temperature, ensuring they are kept away from light and moisture. Do not store tablets in the bathroom. For liquid suspensions, store them in the refrigerator. Do not freeze the suspension. Discard any unused suspension after 14 days. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed, following local disposal regulations. Important Information About This Product: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific condition. This information is not intended to replace personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete and tailored guidance regarding this product and your health needs. Formulary and Plan Information: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary details, first create a list of plans. Your list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider.
